title: Filter the invoice list by status
body:
When I look for overdue invoices, `python -m invoicing list` shows everything and I have to search by eye.

Please add a `--status` option to `list`:

- [ ] `python -m invoicing list --status overdue` shows only the overdue invoices
- [ ] The option accepts every invoice status: draft, sent, paid, overdue
- [ ] Without `--status`, `list` shows all invoices as before

comments.body: Could the option take several statuses at once, like `--status sent,overdue`? That's what I'd use for the weekly dunning run.
Yes, please. And an unknown status should fail with a message that lists the valid ones, instead of just printing nothing.
